reference_uncertainty: Survey Taylor-linearized 95% t intervals, no model/transport uncertainty included
generated_uncertainty: Point estimates only; seeds represent simulation variation
direction: Directions of positive means/proportions are tautological, so direction agreement is meaningful for association/curvature/ordered contrast endpoints only.
geometric: Cell estimate is mean-logTG; exp_estimate/mean_mg_dl is geometric mean. Ordered log contrast exponentiates to geometric-mean ratio.
threshold: Reserved evaluation-only diagnostics, calculated for both synthetic and reference values only after authorized release; excluded from source fitting and never returned to the builder for tuning. Untruncated reference Wald CIs may cross probability bounds; flags retained.
limits: Different period within NHANES, not independent study; complete-case sampling limits representativeness. No causal, individual-recovery, clinical-reliability or uncertainty-calibration claim. Seeds quantify simulation variation, not new clinical evidence. No post-release tuning.
